page.notes: The marginal reference "Exe. 1. 1." is hard to read; it is probably Ezra 1. 1. (the text is Ezra 1:1, "suscitavit Dominus spiritum Cyri"). The sign after "potest" is an unclear mark, not a letter. The signs ♦ after "Ergo", "Prob", "anteced" and "actus" are printed symbols and are copied as they stand. Edge marks at the far right margin are not text and are left out. The word after "volitio-" is the catchword "nis", so it is not repeated in the text.
